lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A repetitive grid of approximately 4-5 horizontal rows of circular high-luminance spots distributed across the mid-lateral flank, forming a consistent spatial pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating localized high-luminance nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper third of the flank exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from superior high-luminance to inferior shadow.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 7-9 high-luminance blobs are visible within the trailing edge and basal portion of the first dorsal fin's mask.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of dark, elongated biological shapes (remoras) is attached to the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin.
